pages.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGIST.
No. I. C. D. 1218.
Date 30 - 4 - 30.

April 30, 30.

Superintendent Whiting,
Shanghai Special District Court.

I return herewith Summons No. 720,
issued at the request of the Chinkiang District
Court, as the person referred to cannot be
located. It is reported that she has
proceeded to Chinkiang.

Deputy Commissioner
(Crime & Special Branches).
pages.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处登记簿
编号：I. C. D. 1218。
日期：30年4月30日。

1930年4月30日。

惠廷警司，
上海特区法院。

现随函退回第720号传票，该传票系应镇江地方法院之请求签发，因所指之人无法找到。据报，她已前往镇江。

副总监
（刑事及政治部）。

POLICE FORCE,
MUNICIPAL COUNCIL.
Shanghai, April 29 1930
To: Officer i/c Special Branch

Reference to the attached,
the bar Chong Young & Co
formerly at 220 Nanking Rd.
is now closed. The person
mentioned in the attached
Summons No 428 cannot be
located; she is reported to have
gone to Chekiang. I suggest
the Summons be returned
to Court.
JW Jones

致：政治部主管警官

关于附件事宜，

法院。
JW Jones

Despatch Summons No. 720 Issued at Request
of Chinkiang District Court

Chinkiang District Court vs. Doen Nyi Sz (wife of
Doen Ang Sun) c/o Dar Cheng Tsung Silk Hong, 400
Hankow Road.

To appear at the Shanghai Special District Court at
10 a.m. on the 30-4-30 to answer certain interrogatories
(re false pretences etc) in respect of a letter
received by this Court from Chinkiang District Court.
pages.zh:
发送第720号传票，该传票系应
镇江地方法院之请求签发

镇江地方法院诉 Doen Nyi Sz（Doen Ang Sun 之妻），通讯处为汉口路400号 Dar Cheng Tsung 丝行。

于1930年4月30日上午10时在上海特区法院出庭，就本法院从镇江地方法院收到的一封信件所涉某些质询事项（关于虚假借口等）作出答复。
